task.task_name: Register v2 published devices for mailbox authorization
task.description: Make the three real-router RED tests green by atomically persisting the root-verified DeviceRecord embedded in a successful v2 bundle under the existing mailbox authorization index.
acceptance_criteria: Only a fully validated successful v2 publish creates the existing device_record:<identity>:<device> authorization record.
Bundle, OTK indexes and DeviceRecord commit in the same Badger transaction and persist across restart.
Idempotent identical republish preserves/backfills the same verified DeviceRecord, while bundle conflict or invalid signature cannot replace it.
Mailbox challenge accepts the original signing device and rejects a different device key.
All three supplied tests plus full tagged race and untagged Go suites pass unchanged.
task.context: Validation already has an ordered parsed DeviceRecord and proves its root signature before returning model.SignalPreKeyBundleV2. Carry a model.DeviceRecord into the validated model and persist it using the exact existing device_record:<identity_id>:<device_id> key inside SaveSignalV2's transaction. Avoid a second repository transaction. On an existing authorization record, require the same verified identity/device/public key and do not overwrite a conflict. Preserve exact raw bundle bytes and all permanent OTK semantics. No commits.
task.module_patterns: Go validation to model to Badger repository; one transaction; existing DeviceRecord JSON format and mailbox handler authorization.

test_case_specs.run_command: cd apps/relay && go test -race -tags=relayv2 ./internal/api/router && go test -race -tags=relayv2 ./...
